summary.en: Fixes assigning Alt Gr as the Push-to-Talk key on Windows.

title.en: Alt Gr for Push-to-Talk on Windows

description.en: Voice settings now recognize Alt Gr as the physical right Alt key when Windows also sends a left Ctrl event. Left Ctrl can still be assigned separately.

en: Before updating, create and verify external backups of PostgreSQL, both Garage volumes, and deployment configuration and secrets. Keep the existing Compose project or platform resource and persistent-volume mappings. If you are updating from an older version, follow the intervening release instructions.

Set NEBULYNK_VERSION=0.8.4, pull the backend, frontend and transcription-worker images, and recreate all three services together. Stop the old backend completely before starting its replacement and allow at least 75 seconds for shutdown.
Wait for GET /health/ready and the worker health check to pass, then verify login, chat and Push-to-Talk.
If a previous Alt Gr assignment shows left Ctrl, assign Alt Gr again in Voice settings. For global Push-to-Talk, approve the new AltRight binding in the PTT Helper.
